notes: Page 84. Top Ge'ez arke closes Day 20 (Abba John Hagir; ends p83 doxology). No Amharic arke exists in source. ¶፳፬-፴ = Elisha (Day 20, second commemoration), numerals read from scan (፳ glyph) and inferred from sequence. Elisha arke follows ¶፴ (Ge'ez only).
